parameters.jsCode: const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const r=$json||{}; const ok=String(r.code??'')==='0'&&Array.isArray(r.data); const a=ok?(r.data[0]||{}):{}; const d=Array.isArray(a.details)?a.details:[]; const usdt=d.find(x=>x.ccy==='USDT'); const p=s.pendingTrade?.status==='pending'&&Date.now()<Number(s.pendingTrade.expiresAt||0)?s.pendingTrade:null; return [{json:{ok:true,mode:'LIVE_ASSIST',market:{ok:!!s.lastMarket?.marketOk,pair:s.lastMarket?.pair||null,last:s.lastMarket?.last||null,universe:s.lastMarket?.universe||0},account:{ok,totalEq:a.totalEq||null,balance:usdt?.availBal||usdt?.cashBal||null,currency:'USDT',message:ok?'OK':(r.msg||r.message||r.error?.message||'Auth unavailable')},scanner:{state:s.lastMarket?.marketOk?'Active':'Standby',pair:s.lastMarket?.pair||null,signal:p?p.reason:'Waiting for valid signal'},strategy:{mode:'Live Assist',confirmationRequired:true,minQuote:5,maxQuote:10},proposal:p,position:s.position||null,lastOrder:s.lastOrder||null,lastRun:{status:s.lastMarket?.marketOk?'Success':'Standby',at:s.lastMarket?.at||null},events:[s.lastEvent||{message:'JOHN ready',time:new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}]}}];

const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const b=$json.body||$json; const p=s.pendingTrade; const id=String(b.proposalId||''); const dec=String(b.decision||'').toLowerCase(); const no=(m,ok=false)=>[{json:{execute:false,ok,message:m}}]; if(!p||p.id!==id)return no('Proposal mismatch'); if(p.status!=='pending')return no('Proposal '+p.status); if(Date.now()>=Number(p.expiresAt||0)){p.status='expired';return no('Proposal expired');} if(dec==='reject'){p.status='rejected';s.lastEvent={at:new Date().toISOString(),message:'Trade rejected by user'};return no('Trade rejected',true);} if(dec!=='approve')return no('Decision must be approve or reject'); const amt=Number(p.amountQuote); if(!Number.isFinite(amt)||![5,10].includes(amt))return no('Risk guard blocked amount'); p.status='approved';p.confirmedAt=Date.now();return [{json:{execute:true,ok:true,proposal:p}}];

const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const p=$json.proposal; const ts=new Date().toISOString(); const path='/api/v5/trade/order'; let bodyObj={instId:p.pair,tdMode:'cash',side:p.side,ordType:'market',clOrdId:String(p.id).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,'').slice(0,32)}; if(p.side==='buy'){bodyObj.sz=String(p.amountQuote);bodyObj.tgtCcy='quote_ccy';} else {const q=Number(s.position?.baseQty||0); if(!(q>0)||s.position?.pair!==p.pair)throw new Error('SELL_POSITION_MISMATCH'); bodyObj.sz=String(Number((q*.99).toFixed(8)));bodyObj.tgtCcy='base_ccy';} const body=JSON.stringify(bodyObj); return [{json:{timestamp:ts,requestPath:path,prehash:ts+'POST'+path+body,body,proposal:p}}];

parameters.jsCode: const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const r=$json||{}; const p=s.pendingTrade; const ok=String(r.code??'')==='0'&&Array.isArray(r.data)&&String(r.data[0]?.sCode??'0')==='0'; if(!ok){if(p)p.status='order_error';s.lastOrder={ok:false,at:new Date().toISOString(),message:r.msg||r.data?.[0]?.sMsg||'Order rejected'};return [{json:{ok:false,status:'order_error',message:s.lastOrder.message}}];} const ordId=String(r.data[0].ordId||'');if(p){p.status='submitted';p.ordId=ordId;} if(p?.side==='buy'){const est=(Number(p.amountQuote)/Number(p.entry))*.995;s.position={status:'open',pair:p.pair,baseQty:String(Number(est.toFixed(8))),entry:p.entry,amountQuote:p.amountQuote,stopLoss:p.stopLoss,takeProfit:p.takeProfit,ordId};} if(p?.side==='sell')s.position=null; s.lastOrder={ok:true,at:new Date().toISOString(),ordId,pair:p?.pair,side:p?.side,status:'submitted'};s.lastEvent={at:new Date().toISOString(),message:String(p?.side||'trade').toUpperCase()+' order submitted '+String(p?.pair||'')};return [{json:{ok:true,status:'submitted',ordId,pair:p?.pair,side:p?.side}}];

parameters.content:
## JOHN LIVE ASSIST v2

Top-20 liquid OKX SPOT scanner.
REAL MONEY only after explicit human confirmation.
- 5 USDT normal / 10 USDT high confidence
- One open position at a time
- Proposal expires after 20 min
- BUY risk thresholds: SL -1.5%, TP +3%
- No leverage
- No transfer / withdrawal nodes
- Keep workflow inactive until Balance Read + Telegram test pass.
